methods.context_diagnostic: Prepend only the same example preceding Prefixes section, plus one newline. This is an offline diagnostic, not a runtime prompt repair; no task prefixes or missing declarations invented.
methods.extraction: Exact anchored known section boundaries; spans refer to named parent text. All strings hashed as UTF-8. Remove only complete ```turtle and ``` lines inside Expected Output; preserve all remaining bytes, including escapes and whitespace.
methods.limits: Examples may be illustrative/context-dependent; no claim each was intended as a self-contained output. No causal claim about fences and generated responses; no model performance evaluation. Parser errors identify encountered faults only, not all possible downstream faults.
methods.source_identity: All 192 system/user prompts equal their frozen 24 original counterparts exactly, including EN bytes. Example source files match after outer whitespace stripping only; exact source and extraction hashes retained.
methods.validity: Turtle parsing and pySHACL meta-SHACL are separate. Meta checks run only after parse success, with empty data; data conformance, semantic correctness and natural-language agreement are not measured.

scope: Source-only frozen few-shot formatting audit; no generated outputs or ledgers read; zero paid calls.
